extDesc.message: Semantic search across the pages you have read. Everything happens locally — nothing ever leaves your device.

tagline.message: You've seen it. Déjà finds it.

searchPlaceholder.message: Describe what you remember… e.g. "article about sodium-based batteries"

statusSearching.message: Digging through memory… (the first search loads the model, ~10-30 s)

statusEmpty.message: Nothing surfaced. Either you never read it, or Déjà hasn't memorised it yet.

popupClearConfirm.message: Delete everything memorised? No going back.

optRetentionHelp.message: Older pages are deleted automatically once a day.

optDenylistHelp.message: One pattern per line. Matches part of the address, e.g. "example.com" or "/private".

optModelHostHelp.message: Empty = huggingface.co. Set your own server for offline/corporate environments.

omniboxDefault.message: Ask your memory — Déjà searches by meaning

memoryEmpty.message: Memory is empty — browse a few pages and come back.

memoryImportConfirm.message: Restore from archive? Matching pages will be overwritten.

optModelHostInvalid.message: The mirror must be an https:// address

welcomeIntro.message: From this moment I remember what you read, so you can find it later by meaning — in your own words, not the exact title.

welcomePoint1.message: Everything happens on your device. No servers, no cloud, no data sent — anywhere, ever.

welcomePoint2.message: Mail, chats, logins and banking are never memorised. Heads up: I can't recognise sensitive topics by address — for those, use pause or your own list in settings.

welcomePoint3.message: You're in charge: pause with one click, "Clear memory" deletes everything, and optionally I forget automatically after a few months.
